popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer names Oileus as father of the Locrian Ajax — the swift lesser Ajax who leads forty ships from Locris and stands apart from Telamonian Ajax.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius lists Oileus among the Argonauts — the Locrian hero as an earlier generation before his son's Trojan fame.

popCulture.title: Ajax the Lesser
popCulture.description: Oileus' son — the Locrian Ajax of the sack of Troy and Athena's storm, forever tagged as son of Oileus to keep him from Telamon's heir.

popCulture.title: Oileus
popCulture.description: King of Locris, Argonaut, father of Ajax the Lesser — the Locrian stem behind the lesser Ajax of the Iliad.
